title: Apache smoke runtime does not materialize MIME configuration at every ServerRoot-resolved location
title_de: Apache-Smoke-Runtime materialisiert die MIME-Konfiguration nicht an jeder von ServerRoot aufgelösten Stelle
security_invariant: For every generated Apache smoke runtime, every default Apache configuration file resolved relative to ServerRoot must be materialized at the actual runtime path before process start; a successful configuration parse alone is insufficient evidence of process liveness or request handling.
security_invariant_de: Für jede erzeugte Apache-Smoke-Runtime muss jede relativ zu ServerRoot aufgelöste Standard-Apache-Konfigurationsdatei vor dem Prozessstart am tatsächlichen Runtime-Pfad materialisiert sein; ein erfolgreicher Konfigurationsparse allein ist keine ausreichende Evidence für Prozess-Liveness oder Request-Handling.
protocol: Apache smoke runtime startup, HTTP/1.1 phase-2 deny, and SIGUSR1 graceful-restart boundary
profile: resulting Parent master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697, tree-identical to final PR #183 head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118
summary: The Apache smoke harness generated only $RUNTIME_ROOT/conf/mime.types although ServerRoot resolves default mime.types at $RUNTIME_ROOT/mime.types. Pre-fix parsing returned Syntax OK, but startup failed with AH01597 before a request. Final PR #183 head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118 carries the dual-location MIME repair and was merged as Parent master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697 with the same tree c4d08e66d9b1929f4a56c81f3d5a021ea6ce4ef0. All 14 master-SHA workflows succeeded; detached-master focused Apache/MIME unit checks and make check-apache-common-adoption passed. No fresh master live start/readiness/403/SIGUSR1 run was supplied, so the P1 Apache smoke/runtime condition remains fixed, not verified or closed.
summary_de: Der Apache-Smoke-Harness erzeugte nur $RUNTIME_ROOT/conf/mime.types, obwohl ServerRoot Standard-mime.types bei $RUNTIME_ROOT/mime.types auflöst. Pre-Fix-Parsing ergab Syntax OK, aber der Start schlug vor einem Request mit AH01597 fehl. Der finale PR-#183-Head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118 enthält die Dual-Location-MIME-Reparatur und wurde als Parent-master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697 mit demselben Tree c4d08e66d9b1929f4a56c81f3d5a021ea6ce4ef0 gemergt. Alle 14 Master-SHA-Workflows waren erfolgreich; fokussierte Apache/MIME-Unit-Checks und make check-apache-common-adoption auf detached Master bestanden. Es wurde kein frischer Master-Live-Start-/Readiness-/403-/SIGUSR1-Lauf geliefert, daher bleibt der P1-Apache-Smoke-/Runtime-Zustand fixed, nicht verified oder closed.
observed_behavior: Pre-fix, run_apache_smoke.sh defined and populated only MIME_TYPES_FILE=$RUNTIME_ROOT/conf/mime.types. The generated apache_smoke.conf sets ServerRoot to RUNTIME_ROOT. The retained configtest log says Syntax OK, while the retained Apache error log records AH01597: it cannot open RUNTIME_ROOT/mime.types. Thus configuration parsing did not prove the process could start. The mutable repair defines MIME_TYPES_ROOT_FILE=$RUNTIME_ROOT/mime.types and copies or creates the same generated artifact in both paths. The post-fix retained phase2 result reports expected_status=403, actual_status=403, status=pass, and live_executed=true; its error log records SIGUSR1 received and graceful restart. The local repair is not a committed PR head.
observed_behavior_de: Pre-Fix definierte und befüllte run_apache_smoke.sh nur MIME_TYPES_FILE=$RUNTIME_ROOT/conf/mime.types. Die erzeugte apache_smoke.conf setzt ServerRoot auf RUNTIME_ROOT. Das zurückgehaltene Configtest-Log sagt Syntax OK, während das zurückgehaltene Apache-Error-Log AH01597 aufzeichnet: RUNTIME_ROOT/mime.types kann nicht geöffnet werden. Konfigurationsparsing bewies daher nicht, dass der Prozess starten kann. Die mutierbare Reparatur definiert MIME_TYPES_ROOT_FILE=$RUNTIME_ROOT/mime.types und kopiert oder erzeugt dasselbe generierte Artefakt an beiden Pfaden. Das post-fix zurückgehaltene phase2-Ergebnis meldet expected_status=403, actual_status=403, status=pass und live_executed=true; sein Error-Log zeichnet SIGUSR1 received und graceful restart auf. Die lokale Reparatur ist kein committeter PR-Head.
expected_behavior: The smoke harness must generate a MIME artifact at every Apache path that the rendered ServerRoot-relative default configuration resolves before process start. Apache configuration parsing, startup/readiness, the legitimate phase-2 HTTP/1.1 deny control, and a SIGUSR1 graceful-restart/readiness control must all pass without relying on unrelated source-tree files. The repair must be independently committed and exact-head validated before a resulting-master rerun can support verified or closed status.
expected_behavior_de: Der Smoke-Harness muss vor dem Prozessstart ein MIME-Artefakt an jedem Apache-Pfad erzeugen, den die gerenderte ServerRoot-relative Standardkonfiguration auflöst. Apache-Konfigurationsparsing, Start/Readiness, der legitime phase-2-HTTP/1.1-Deny-Control und ein SIGUSR1-Graceful-Restart-/Readiness-Control müssen alle ohne Abhängigkeit von fremden Source-Tree-Dateien bestehen. Die Reparatur muss unabhängig committet und auf einem exakten Head validiert sein, bevor ein Rerun auf dem resultierenden Master einen verified- oder closed-Status stützen kann.
impact: A cleanly parsed Apache smoke configuration can still fail before serving a single request, invalidating the normal Apache runtime acceptance path and blocking release delivery for that path. The evidence establishes no attacker-controlled input, remote execution, secret exposure, or request-processing exploit. The P1 release blocker applies to Apache smoke/runtime acceptance, not to the independent selective #94A attribution.
impact_de: Eine sauber geparste Apache-Smoke-Konfiguration kann dennoch vor dem ersten Request fehlschlagen, invalidiert damit den normalen Apache-Runtime-Akzeptanzpfad und blockiert die Release-Delivery für diesen Pfad. Die Evidence etabliert keinen attacker-kontrollierten Input, keine Remote-Execution, keine Secret-Exposition und keinen Request-Processing-Exploit. Der P1-Release-Blocker gilt für Apache-Smoke-/Runtime-Akzeptanz, nicht für die unabhängige Attribution von selektivem #94A.
preconditions: An Apache smoke runtime uses connectors/apache/harness/apache_smoke.conf with ServerRoot equal to its generated runtime root.
The available Apache mod_mime uses its default relative mime.types resolution.
The runtime root is fresh and does not accidentally contain a pre-existing root-level mime.types file.
reproduction: Generate a fresh Apache smoke runtime with the baseline harness and confirm it creates conf/mime.types but not ServerRoot/mime.types.
Run apache2 -t against the generated configuration; observe that Syntax OK does not prove a successful process start.
Start Apache and retain the error log showing AH01597 for the missing ServerRoot-relative mime.types before any request is served.
Apply the dual-location MIME artifact repair in an isolated task candidate and assert both runtime files exist with the same digest.
Run the phase2_args_block HTTP/1.1 control and the SIGUSR1 graceful-restart/readiness control; then repeat them from a committed PR exact head and resulting master.

evidence.command: sha256sum retained configtest.log; apache2 -t reported Syntax OK
evidence.result: The exact generated configuration parses successfully, proving that config parsing alone does not establish process liveness.

evidence.command: sha256sum retained error.log; rg AH01597 error.log
evidence.result: Apache fails before a request with AH01597 because ServerRoot/mime.types is absent even though conf/mime.types exists.

An uncommitted harness snapshot defines MIME_TYPES_ROOT_FILE and writes the generated MIME artifact at both ServerRoot-relative and conf paths; Git HEAD remains 9f23ae2c5fe908cef38f203be03f93fda75a8dd7.
The uncommitted focused static contract is associated with the local repair and must be run again from a committed PR exact head.

evidence.command: sha256sum both generated MIME artifact paths
evidence.result: Both required generated MIME artifacts exist and have equal content in the local repair control.
The local repair control reports expected_status=403, actual_status=403, status=pass, and live_executed=true for phase2_args_block.

evidence.command: sha256sum retained error.log; rg SIGUSR1 error.log
evidence.result: The local repair runtime log records SIGUSR1 received and a graceful restart, followed by normal Apache operation.
The control starts Apache, confirms HTTP/1.1 readiness, sends SIGUSR1, and confirms readiness again. It is local candidate evidence, not a committed exact-PR-head receipt.

evidence.artifact_path: Parent-supplied PR #183 resulting-master delivery and focused Apache/MIME-check summary
evidence.command: git show -s --format='%H%n%T%n%ci%n%s' 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697; git show -s --format='%H%n%T%n%ci%n%s' 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118; git diff --quiet 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118; Parent-supplied master workflow and local-check summary
evidence.result: PR #183 merged as master 154ee724eba4653fa6378fc3c8729ae433e65697 with tree c4d08e66d9b1929f4a56c81f3d5a021ea6ce4ef0 equal to final head 4e4dfb36e1b05f7eda38450fd3710e3a04905118. All 14 master-SHA workflows succeeded; detached-master focused Apache/MIME unit checks and make check-apache-common-adoption passed. No fresh master live start/readiness/403/SIGUSR1 run was supplied.

root_cause: The Parent-owned smoke harness creates only the conf-relative MIME artifact even though the rendered configuration's ServerRoot is the runtime root and the available Apache mod_mime resolves default mime.types relative to that root. A syntax-only configuration test does not open the default file on the process-start path, so it does not detect the missing root-level artifact.
root_cause_de: Der Parent-eigene Smoke-Harness erzeugt nur das conf-relative MIME-Artefakt, obwohl ServerRoot der gerenderten Konfiguration der Runtime-Root ist und das verfügbare Apache-mod_mime standardmäßig mime.types relativ zu diesem Root auflöst. Ein reiner Syntax-Konfigurationstest öffnet die Standarddatei nicht auf dem Prozessstart-Pfad und erkennt daher das fehlende Root-Level-Artefakt nicht.
proposed_remediation: Keep the merged dual-location MIME repair and focused static contract. To verify it, create a fresh resulting-master runtime and run apache2 -t, live start/readiness, phase2_args_block HTTP/1.1 403, and SIGUSR1 graceful restart/readiness with retained logs and status receipts. Do not infer those live controls from tree identity, focused unit tests, or successful workflows.
proposed_remediation_de: Die gemergte Dual-Location-MIME-Reparatur und den fokussierten Static-Contract beibehalten. Zur Verifikation eine frische Resulting-Master-Runtime erzeugen und apache2 -t, Live-Start-/Readiness, phase2_args_block-HTTP/1.1-403 sowie SIGUSR1-Graceful-Restart-/Readiness mit aufbewahrten Logs und Status-Receipts ausführen. Diese Live-Controls nicht aus Tree-Identität, fokussierten Unit-Tests oder erfolgreichen Workflows ableiten.
acceptance_criteria: A fresh smoke runtime contains both ServerRoot/mime.types and ServerRoot/conf/mime.types with the expected source digest before Apache starts.
apache2 -t and an actual Apache process start/readiness control pass against the generated runtime without fallback to unrelated source-tree files.
The selected HTTP/1.1 phase2_args_block legitimate control returns 403 from a live Apache process.
A SIGUSR1 graceful restart is followed by successful readiness and selected legitimate request handling.
A focused regression contract rejects a harness that writes only one of the required generated MIME locations.
A fresh resulting-master live start/readiness/403/SIGUSR1 sequence exists before verified or closed status; tree identity, focused unit tests, and successful workflows alone are insufficient.
validation_plan: Retain the passed detached-master focused Apache/MIME unit checks and make check-apache-common-adoption as source-level evidence only.
Create a fresh resulting-master runtime and hash both generated MIME locations before Apache starts.
Run apache2 -t, live start/readiness, phase2_args_block HTTP/1.1, and SIGUSR1 graceful-restart/readiness controls with retained logs and status receipts.
Run live start/readiness, phase2_args_block HTTP/1.1 403, and SIGUSR1 graceful-restart/readiness on resulting master before terminal disposition.
regression_tests: Fresh Apache smoke-harness runtime configuration/start control.
legitimate_control_tests: apache2 -t against the generated configuration returns Syntax OK.
A live Apache process exposes the normal readiness endpoint before and after SIGUSR1.
The normal phase2_args_block request receives expected HTTP 403 from the live process.
dependencies: Approved Apache/httpd, APXS, APR, and libModSecurity runtime environment.
Fresh resulting-master Apache smoke runtime root for terminal validation.
deduplication_note: This is distinct from FND-PARENT-0070: 0070 owns APXS DSO source-materialization completeness in connectors/apache/build/apxs-wrapper.in, whereas this record owns generated Apache smoke-runtime configuration artifact placement in connectors/apache/harness/run_apache_smoke.sh. residual_risk: The repair is merged and all 14 master-SHA workflows succeeded, but no fresh resulting-master live Apache start/readiness/403/SIGUSR1 receipt is recorded. A hidden runtime mismatch could still invalidate startup or post-restart service. The scoped defect establishes no attacker-controlled vulnerability and is fixed, not verified or closed.
residual_risk_de: Die Reparatur ist gemergt und alle 14 Master-SHA-Workflows waren erfolgreich, aber es ist kein frischer Resulting-Master-Live-Apache-Start-/Readiness-/403-/SIGUSR1-Receipt erfasst. Ein verdeckter Runtime-Mismatch könnte Start oder Dienst nach Restart weiterhin invalidieren. Der begrenzte Defekt etabliert keine attacker-kontrollierte Vulnerability und ist fixed, nicht verified oder closed.
